title: Arcwire Ascent
creation_method: MusicSaas Gateway game_bgm / SA3 small stereo master; first 64 seconds form the game mix, full single-pass 128-second master forms the station mix; -3 dB gain before AAC encoding. PCM preflight cannot independently prove inference mode or musical quality; human review remains required.
generation_prompt: Original uplifting trance instrumental for an all-ages one-or-two-key rhythm game, around 138 BPM with a steady countable 4/4 kick and clear transients. An ascending three-note electric-glass arpeggio opens the piece; warm rolling bass, bright offbeat chords, precise claps and airy synth harmonies build around it. At the midpoint, thin the drums and answer the hook with a new descending melody, then return to a fuller rhythmic finale. Distinct musical development across a single 128-second composition, spacious stereo, energetic but not harsh, no vocals, no speech, no samples, no known melody.

art_provenance.cover_prompt: Create a brand-new original SQUARE 1:1 album-cover illustration for an internal duohertz electronic rhythm-game track named Arcwire Ascent. Original high-contrast editorial comic collage: near-black ink, warm ivory paper, coral red, electric cyan, and a tiny warm yellow accent. Central motif: three ascending luminous zigzag arcwires rising diagonally through layered concentric frequency rings, with sharp paper-cut silhouettes, energetic halftone texture, precise geometry and a playful uplifting trance pulse. Make it bold and legible as a tiny album thumbnail; dynamic but with clear visual hierarchy. All-ages friendly. No humans, no city, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no existing game characters, no imitation of a specific game screen.
art_provenance.og_prompt: Edit the supplied original square Arcwire Ascent artwork into a HORIZONTAL 1200x630-style social card for duohertz. Preserve the same three ascending coral/cyan arcwires, frequency rings, near-black ink, warm ivory and halftone comic collage. Recompose into a wide card with the arcwire motif on the RIGHT two-thirds and clean high-contrast dark/ivory space on the LEFT. Add exactly two highly legible English lines on the left, spelled exactly: line 1 'duohertz' (all lowercase), line 2 'Arcwire Ascent'. Bold original display typography, plenty of contrast, no other words, letters, numbers, logos, people or existing IP. Family-friendly electronic rhythm-game art.
